laws.name: New Jersey Family Leave Act (NJFLA)
laws.description: Provides job-protected unpaid leave for family caregiving and bonding. Does not cover the employee’s own medical condition.

laws.name: New Jersey Family Leave Insurance (FLI)
laws.description: Provides paid benefits for family caregiving and bonding. Funded through employee payroll contributions.

laws.name: New Jersey Temporary Disability Insurance (TDI)
laws.description: Provides paid wage replacement for employees unable to work due to a non-work-related illness, injury, or pregnancy.

laws.name: New Jersey Earned Sick Leave Law
laws.description: Provides paid sick leave for medical needs, family caregiving, school closures, and domestic or sexual violence situations.

laws.name: New Jersey SAFE Act
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for victims of domestic violence or sexual assault to seek medical care, counseling, legal assistance, or safety services.

laws.name: New Jersey State Employee Sick Leave
laws.description: Provides paid sick leave for eligible New Jersey state employees for personal illness or injury.

laws.name: New Jersey State Employee Family Sick Leave
laws.description: Allows New Jersey state employees to use accrued sick leave to care for an immediate family member with an illness or injury.
